commands.summary: RealRunner executed exactly the three registered tasks 0001, 0002, and 0003 under the repopact condition. The harness report retained three errored/non-reportable envelopes because required context/task attribution was unavailable; no baseline arm ran.

The narrow adapter invoked the already-provisioned authenticated Codex CLI separately for each fresh fixture copy and returned repopact.real-runner.v1 failure envelopes without fabricating incomplete telemetry.
The actual model command completed once for each of the three registered tasks. CLI JSON events contained one turn usage snapshot and complete agent/file/command event streams per task.
Proving Ground suite passed all 41 tests, including the added Codex capture-accounting regression test.
Deterministic PactBench self-test passed for all 24 registered tasks.
All three captures passed the repository secret detector. Private machine paths were normalized to placeholders; no credentials, bearer headers, API keys, or secret-like values were retained.

instrumentation_gap.detail: Codex CLI turn.completed usage exposed input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_input_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, and one-turn completion, but did not expose a tokenizer-backed structural split between the registered task request and additional RepoPact context, nor the contract's cache_adjusted_input_tokens. The adapter therefore returned status=failed with no fabricated per-request/aggregate telemetry.
